dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: I carry bridal sedan chairs, and I've just been contracted to carry a new one, but I wanna get a sign for it so the Millelith won't stop us...

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: But as soon as I started to speak, I had this certification form thrown at me. I already got certified ages ago, I came here to get a sign...

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Before I had even finished speaking, she took back the form and said I could go home and wait to be notified of the outcome of my application.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: She didn't listen to me at all... *sigh*
